flowContents.comments: Self-healing test pack: Faults in nested groups, below ports. Built by flows/build_all.py.
flowContents.name: nfh-p25-nested

processGroups.comments: The consumer runs one concurrent task while its input arrives three times faster. (symptom: backlog)
processGroups.name: S98 Slow Consumer One Group Down

processGroups.comments: Failures are routed back into the validator with no limit, so retries starve new input. (symptom: failure_loop)
processGroups.name: S99 Failure Self-Loop Two Groups Down

processGroups.comments: The validator's failure relationship is auto-terminated, so rejected records disappear. (symptom: data_loss)
processGroups.name: S100 Auto-terminated Failures Two Groups Down

processGroups.comments: None. 40 processors in 7 small flows of their own, each far inside its capacity. (symptom: healthy)
processGroups.name: S101 Healthy Groups One Down

processGroups.comments: None. 60 processors in 10 small flows of their own, each far inside its capacity. (symptom: healthy)
processGroups.name: S102 Healthy Groups Two Down
